newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 24.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - July 24.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 26.71 points or 0.33 percent to close at 8,088.36, another new record high.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index jumped 16.06 points or 1.58 percent to 1,034.07, as foreign and local institutions bought-up cheapened index-linked stocks.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.6375/05 a dollar at around 0035 GMT, unchanged from 2.6375/05 at its Kuala Lumpur ending on Wednesday.
* Ringgit will be closely watched ahead of the Friday meeting of Asian central bankers in Shanghai, on the possibility of central bank cooperation on foreign exchange intervention, analysts said.

* Downtrending Malaysian interbank rates a positive factor. The three-month Kuala Lumpur Interbank Offered Rate averaged 8.38 percent in the Wednesday morning market fixing, much lower than 10.30 percent only a week ago.
* Property firm Eupe Corp to list on the main board. The company offered 15 million new and vendor shares at 2.0 ringgit each in its initial public offering.
